name: Elli hikes
description:
Hi, I’m Elli and I love (long-distance)hiking, backpacking and exploring nature.

Thru-hiking the South West Coast Path in England changed so much for me and made me realize that there was something missing in my life: Freedom. I didn’t want to wait for „later“ or continue to tell myself that I would follow my dreams „some day“. All we have is now and life’s too short to do stuff that we’re not happy with.
Which is why I started to follow my real passion: being outside and being creative. A bit scary but something that just feels right.
